column1: # Test chains that share a construct with training once expression tags are set
# aside: the reviewed outcome of every candidate pair.
# Criterion (trizod/dataset/shared_constructs.py, docs/dataset/dataset-construction.md):
# a pinned test chain is retired as shared_construct when, after the expression
# tags of both chains are removed (N- and C-terminal His tags, thrombin, TEV and
# HRV-3C sites, a GB1 fusion, the RIKEN GSSGSSG/SGPSSG flanks), an identical run
# of >= 30 residues with a training chain (split train or redundant) covers
# >= 50 % of the test chain's scored residues. Otherwise it stays a test chain.
# Candidates: every test x training pair whose stripped sequences share an
# identical run of >= 30 residues (source identical_run; an exhaustive 30-mer
# scan), and the 35 pairs on 23 test chains that meet the leakage rule only
# after stripping (source tag_stripped_homology). Computed on the release
# Parquet with `python -m trizod.dataset.shared_constructs`; finalize
# re-derives every row from the release it ships and refuses a stale one.
# test_tags / training_tags: the tags removed; run: longest identical run after
# stripping; test_scored: scored residues of the test chain; scored_in_run: those
# inside the run; coverage: scored_in_run / test_scored; outcome: retire / keep.
# Outcome: 7070_1_1_1 (Prp24 RRM1-2) is retired: an 83-residue run identical to
# training 16243_1_1_1 (Prp24 RRM2-3) holds 82 of its 158 scored residues
# (51.9 %); its row is in test_retirements.tsv. Every other pair is kept: the
# longest other runs are 37 (52143_1_1_1 ~ 53627_1_1_1, 13.7 %) and 34 residues
# (19777_1_1_1 ~ 50256_1_1_1, 16.8 %), and no tag-stripped homology pair shares
# more than 6 identical residues. 30007_1_1_1 ~ 50596_1_1_1 meets the leakage
# rule on an alternative alignment: stage 2 searches with --min-seq-id 0 and
# removes the training chain 50596_1_1_1; the test chain stays.
